claims.value: Large language model with 80B total parameters and 13B active parameters, using MoE architecture.
claims.evidence: Hunyuan-A13B model features a total of 80 billion parameters with 13 billion active parameters.
Natively supports a 256K context window, maintaining stable performance on long-text tasks.

claims.value: Open-source large language model based on fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, designed for efficiency and scalability.
claims.evidence: an innovative and open-source large language model (LLM)
Utilizes Grouped Query Attention (GQA) and supports multiple quantization formats
Enhanced Agent Capabilities: Optimized for agent tasks, achieving leading results on benchmarks such as BFCL-v3, τ-Bench and C3-Bench.
Supports both fast and slow thinking modes, allowing users to flexibly choose according to their needs.
Our model defaults to using slow-thinking reasoning
